ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Bajaj Electricals Limited has confirmed compliance with SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. This indicates that their Registrar and Transfer Agent (RTA) efficiently processed all dematerialisation requests—confirming/rejecting securities, mutilating physical certificates, and updating ownership records within prescribed timelines. This routine filing demonstrates sound operational integrity in handling shareholder records with no material impacts or red flags identified.
